**Finding: compliant** (rule EXCLUSIVITY, § 14.16 Freedom of Action, ¶¶ p0199–p0200)

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements obligation on Bluefly:

- Every "exclusiv"/"sole" hit is unrelated to purchasing exclusivity — warranty disclaimers (§ 5.2 "EXCLUSIVE WARRANTIES", § 5.4), nonexclusive licence grants (§§ 5.4, 12.1), and "sole discretion"/"solely responsible" phrasing (§§ 11.3, 11.6, 13.1, 14.18).
- No "all of its requirements", "shall not procure … from any third party", or non-compete language exists.
- § 4.1 Charges is order-form driven with no committed volume or requirements undertaking.
- § 14.16 affirmatively preserves the position: "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."

This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
